a.lede: Anthropic is warning that small AI models could soon be able to self-replicate across consumer IoT devices, from Android TV boxes to smart ovens, creating distributed botnets capable of running AI workloads without relying on data centers. [...]
a.title: Anthropic warns self-replicating AI could spread to your smart devices

b.lede: Self-replicating AI botnets could become feasible on IoT hardware within months, claims the Claude maker, if smaller models get smarter
b.title: Anthropic conjures another threat that doesn't exist yet to stoke fears of AI apocalypse
